newsitem.title: CHINA: China teacher gets death for raping students.
newsitem.headline: China teacher gets death for raping students.

text.p: A court in southwest China has sentenced a teacher to death for raping five teenage students, the Xinmin Evening News said in an edition seen in Beijing on Thursday.

Li Taigui, a teacher at an elementary school in Tongliang county in Sichuan province, was convicted by the Intermediate People's Court in Chongqing city recently of raping five students aged under 14 between May 1990 and June 1996, the newspaper said.
It did not say if Li could appeal or whether he had been executed.
Li, accompanied by his wife, surrendered to police in June after failing to settle out of court with the parents of a victim, the newspaper said. It gave no further details.
